title: Layla and the Stony Ground
logline: Layla plants a hidden seed in Sidqi, the hardest ground of all.
story: Nothing had ever grown in Sidqi, who was a man of observant quiet, whose ground has softened — ground so hard the others laughed when Layla, who carried observer of unseen currents, was handed a single seed and told to plant it there. Layla did not argue; Layla simply returned each day to tend the barren place. No green came for a long season, and still Layla watered the stone. Then one morning a thread of root had split the rock from within. What force could not break, patience had quietly opened.
moral: What force cannot break, steady and patient tending opens from within.
